annotation.justification: The clause unambiguously requires that an endpoint must not forget a connection ID unless it has retired it, and allows an endpoint to treat an excess of pending retirements beyond the specified limit as a CONNECTION_ID_LIMIT_ERROR. No two materially different interpretations or missing constraints are evident.
